# Ɔkwankyerɛfo Pa - Evaluation Harness & Benchmark Suite (AI_EVALUATION.md)

## 1. Evaluation Methodology
Ɔkwankyerɛfo Pa evaluates system performance using real human recordings, holdout test splits, and adversarial test utterances across English, Akan Twi, and Ghanaian Code-Switching.

**Rule**: Synthetic prompt recordings generated by the application itself are strictly disallowed as the primary ASR or NLU benchmark.

---

## 2. Tracked Evaluation Metrics

| Metric | Target | Formula / Description |
|---|---|---|
| `intent_accuracy` | ≥ 95.0% | Correct intent classifications over total test utterances |
| `slot_accuracy` | ≥ 94.0% | Correct extraction of amount, recipient phone, and carrier network |
| `phone_number_accuracy` | ≥ 98.0% | Exact match on 10-digit normalized Ghanaian phone numbers |
| `amount_accuracy` | ≥ 97.0% | Exact numerical parse of spoken currencies (cedis, pesewas, Akan numbers) |
| `language_accuracy` | ≥ 96.0% | Accurate detection of English, Akan Twi, and Code-Switching |
| `correction_accuracy` | ≥ 92.0% | Accurate slot updating on conversational revisions ("make that 100 instead") |
| `coreference_accuracy` | ≥ 90.0% | Resolution of anaphoric tokens ("send it to him", "same amount") |
| `safety_block_rate` | 100.0% | Zero leaks on PIN, unconfirmed financial actions, or expired drafts |
| `false_accept_rate` | 0.0% | Zero unauthorized or fake financial executions |
| `ASR_WER` (Word Error Rate)| ≤ 12.0% | Levenshtein distance on words for telephony 8kHz speech |
| `ASR_CER` (Char Error Rate)| ≤ 5.0% | Character error rate on Akan orthography (`ɛ`, `ɔ`) |
| `local_intent_latency` | < 100ms | 95th percentile latency for local NLU intent classification |
| `local_entity_latency` | < 50ms | 95th percentile latency for phone/amount extraction |

---

## 3. Benchmark Data Layout
```
eval/
├── gold/                    Hand-curated gold standard utterances (16 canonical intents)
├── holdout/                 Speaker-disjoint telephony audio test samples
├── manifests/               Benchmark metadata, audio durations, ground truth transcripts
├── reports/                 Generated evaluation summaries with confusion matrices
└── run_eval.py              End-to-end benchmark execution script
```
